edges.reason: Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, granting full owner privileges to the deployer.
buy() requires msg.sender == tx.origin, an origin-based authorization check.
Fallback requires msg.sender == tx.origin before purchasing.
withdraw() requires msg.sender == tx.origin before paying out.
sell() requires msg.sender == tx.origin before burning tokens.
transfer() reaches the tx.origin check through onlyApprovedContracts.
excludeWhale() requires msg.sender == tx.origin.
purchaseTokens() requires msg.sender == tx.origin.
reinvest() requires msg.sender == tx.origin.
exit() requires msg.sender == tx.origin before selling and withdrawing.
buy() delegates the purchase to excludeWhale().
Fallback delegates the purchase to excludeWhale(0x0).
excludeWhale() performs the mint through purchaseTokens().
reinvest() dispatches a buy order through purchaseTokens().
exit() calls sell() with the caller's full token balance.
exit() calls withdraw() after selling.
sell() prices the tokens with tokensToEthereum_().
purchaseTokens() mints tokens using ethereumToTokens_().
purchaseTokens() invokes the lottery/whale payout logic in isWhalePaying().
calculateTokensReceived() uses ethereumToTokens_() for quoting.
calculateEthereumReceived() uses tokensToEthereum_() for quoting.
reinvest() fetches the caller's dividends via myDividends().
withdraw() fetches the caller's dividends via myDividends().
myTokens() reads the caller balance through balanceOf().
myDividends() reads dividendsOf(msg.sender).
totalSupply() reads tokenSupply.
totalSupply() reads lotterySupply.
totalSupply() reads gameSuppply.
purchaseTokens() credits publicTokenLedger for the buyer.
purchaseTokens() mutates tokenSupply before computing per-share dividends.
purchaseTokens() increases profitPerShare_ with the transaction dividends.
purchaseTokens() updates payoutsTo_ with unchecked int256 multiplication and subtraction.
sell() decrements tokenSupply with raw subtraction instead of SafeMath.
sell() adds lottery tokens to lotterySupply.
sell() credits the whale ledger with the whale fee.
isWhalePaying() reads and clears lotteryPlayers when picking a winner.
isWhalePaying() moves the entire lotterySupply to the winner.
isWhalePaying() drains whaleLedger[owner] into payoutDividends.
The lottery winner index is computed from blockhash inside isWhalePaying(), giving miners influence over fund distribution.
withdraw() pushes ether to the caller-controlled address, an external call that could be reentered.
sell() performs unchecked subtraction on supply and ledger balances.
The ether transfer recipient is derived from msg.sender, making the external call caller-controlled.
publicTokenLedger is keyed by msg.sender throughout buy, sell and transfer.
gamePlayers records the caller as a player of the target game.
setGames() requires msg.sender to equal the stored owner.
goPublic() requires msg.sender to equal the stored owner.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against state variable owner before allowing setGames().

Quoted ether input only exists for the quoting helper.
Quoted token input only exists for the quoting helper.

Referral is validated and credited only inside purchaseTokens().
